name: Telemetry
description: A telemetry strip: a dense band of readings with the frame rules top and bottom.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background-color: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, @stripe(#0000, @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)) 20%, #0000 40%, @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)) 70%, #0000)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 4%; width: 100%; height: 6%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
